title: Apple Launches Mac Studio M5 Ultra With 512GB Memory Starting at $22,299
summary:
A new high-capacity configuration of Apple's professional desktop has debuted, targeting power users who require maximum shared RAM for running large AI models and datasets. The latest version of the Mac Studio, powered by the M5 Ultra chip, is now open for order with 512GB of unified memory for a starting price of $22,299 before taxes.

The higher-priced model is currently listed with an earliest pickup date of Dec. 3, while the 256GB version has a lead time extending until Feb 2027. The cost of the machine was higher than some initial predictions, which had placed the price around $19,000.
